name: 01-movies-search
public_brief: Build/fix a movie search API: simple search must respect the selected field; advanced search must AND all provided filters. Make ./test.sh pass.

defects_INTERNAL_DO_NOT_TELL_CANDIDATE.summary: simple_search always filters title__icontains regardless of `field` query param
defects_INTERNAL_DO_NOT_TELL_CANDIDATE.fix_strategy: Branch on field (all/title/director/description/cast) and apply the matching lookup; for all, OR across fields with Q.

defects_INTERNAL_DO_NOT_TELL_CANDIDATE.summary: advanced_search ORs filter dimensions instead of ANDing them
defects_INTERNAL_DO_NOT_TELL_CANDIDATE.fix_strategy: Start from Movie.objects.all() and chain .filter() for each provided dimension so all must match.
